questions.stem: The human body contains only about 50g of ATP at any time, yet uses 40-70 kg per day. How is this possible?

options.text: The body makes new ATP from scratch each time
Each ATP molecule is recycled hundreds of times per day
The body stores extra ATP in the liver
Most of the ATP comes from food directly

questions.explanation: ATP is rapidly recycled. Each ATP molecule is broken down to ADP and then reformed approximately 500 times per day. This continuous recycling means a small amount of ATP can do a huge amount of work.
